node: Election-sensitive public spending infrastructure: grid, security, permitting, and public works
summary: Layer 1B expands this node through a two-lane funnel. Reference lane: Quanta Services is the obvious grid-infrastructure anchor with large, visible backlog, useful mainly as a context benchmark. Underfollowed lane: Primoris, NV5 Global, and OSI Systems map to less crowded bottleneck subnodes: grid-hardening crews and utility construction, permitting/testing/inspection/engineering gates, and border/security inspection infrastructure. The strongest discovery signal is not election-outcome prediction; it is backlog or contract visibility tied to public-sector, utility, DHS/CBP, or regulated infrastructure programs that are difficult to unwind quickly.
